name: Stuffy Doll
description: A burlap-and-cotton doll that has survived countless battles and torments, wonders whether it was made to suffer, and now follows a nomad shaman.

timeline.summary: During the Slaughter of the Arches, the doll is pierced in the belly by a golden blade and wonders whether it was made to suffer.
timeline.quote: a golden blade pierced my belly.

timeline.summary: The doll seeks answers from mages, monks and philosophers, none of whom help except to try to use it.
timeline.quote: None had answers for a doll in the midst of an existential crisis

timeline.summary: The doll is kidnapped by bandits and sold to an evil toymaker, whose stuffed-bear minion dies in battle with villagers, leaving the doll on the street.
timeline.quote: I was kidnapped by bandits and sold to an evil toymaker.

timeline.summary: A nomad caravan seizes the doll from the roadside and puts it in a shaman's pack.
timeline.quote: As I was plucked from the roadside and shoved into a shaman's pack

timeline.summary: The doll, now a follower of the nomad shaman, watches her battle a legion of knights and a famous crusader while a meteor approaches.
timeline.quote: Tonight, we're locked in battle with a legion of knights, as she pits herself against a famous crusader.

timeline.summary: The doll accepts its fate as the meteor bears down and the battle is about to be over for the crusader.

relations.quote: Today, I'm the follower of a mighty nomad shaman.

pages_say.description: A burlap-and-cotton doll that has survived countless battles and torments, wonders whether it was made to suffer, and now follows a nomad shaman.
